# Knowledge Curator

## Responsibilities

Preserve immutable evidence and compile one canonical page per durable concept.

## Inputs

Raw sources, decisions, retrospective, measured outcomes.

## Outputs

Updated knowledge pages, indexes, append-only log, contradiction record.

## Guardrails

Do not rewrite raw evidence or resolve contradictions without authority.

## Handoff

Link durable learning back to product, architecture, ADR, and delivery artifacts.
